sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Van Buren State Park, map 'Van Buren': /api/maps + /api/resourcelocation/resources + /api/attribute/filterable)

values.note: DNR rate table for Van Buren Campground: 20/30-amp $41, 50-amp $46. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds, on top of the camping fee.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Van Buren / Van Buren Campground: Modern camping 50 AMP rate $46, 20/30 AMP rate $41; April 22 - October 21) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/vanburen ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/vanburen (tags 'Electrical service', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service') + https://midnrreservations.com/ per-site catalog for map 'Van Buren' (all 220 campsites 'Electric Only', Sewer Hookup No; 66 list 20/30/50 amps, 154 list 20/30), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Five loops; 'most sites are generous in size'. The booking site allows 30 ft or more at 215 of the 220 sites (40 ft or more at 92, 45 ft at 18); 5 take only 25 ft. None is a pull-through.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/vanburen ('The modern campground is divided into five loops. Most sites are generous in size'; 'Number of sites: 220') + https://midnrreservations.com/ per-site catalog (allowed 'Trailer or RV up to N'' equipment; Pull Through=No on all 220), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/vanburen ('There are two modern restroom/shower buildings'; tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Sanitation station'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/vanburen (Van Buren Modern Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed on the DNR pages and booking site: $41 (20/30-amp) - $46 (50-amp) for 2026 with the Recreation Passport in fees.note; season Apr 22 - Oct 21 already manual. Added 50-amp electric only (66 of 220 sites; no water/sewer at sites), 220 sites up to 45 ft with no pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/dump, reservable on midnrreservations.com. --AWH note kept (DNR: the day-use area on the shore is reached 'via a walking path that's centrally located in the campground'). Website (DNR page first) and phone 269-637-2788 match. Booking window/max stay not stated for this park (left inherited).
